name: Flowstep
tagline: AI UI design that exports production React + Tailwind.
description: Flowstep is an AI design tool that generates fully editable UI screens from conversational prompts, supports multi-screen flows, and lets you customize the result by hand. It integrates with Figma for handoff and exports production-ready React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS code, aiming to compress the design-to-code kickoff.
edge: Carries a prompt through to hand-editable screens, Figma handoff, and shippable code — not just a throwaway prototype mockup.
cons: Best for kickoff, not full builds
